items.description:
Onderstepoort Biological Products (OBP) is a state-owned animal vaccine manufacturer that has worked from its Onderstepoort base since its inception in 2000 to develop and produce vaccines protecting cattle, sheep, horses and goats against the bacterial and viral diseases that threaten livestock health and food security. Its product range is organised by species, running through to dedicated vaccination programmes for cattle, sheep and goats, with published product booklets setting out the full catalogue for buyers.

Buyers can order through the company's own e-procurement system rather than relying solely on distributors, and OBP recruits through a dedicated careers portal for anyone wanting to join its bio-science team. Based in Onderstepoort, Pretoria, OBP suits veterinarians, farmers and animal health distributors needing vaccines produced specifically for Southern African livestock conditions rather than imported alternatives.

Palisade Factory, in Klerksoord, Akasia, is a well-established steel fencing manufacturer whose owner brings 36 years of experience in the steel industry to every project. The business manufactures palisade fencing to customer specifications, including swallow tail, 6-spike and 7-spike designs, and also supplies ready-made fence panels and DIY kits for anyone wanting to install their own palisade.

Beyond fencing itself, the factory works with a wide range of raw steel materials, including hot rolled and cold rolled steel, galvanised and stainless steel sheets, round bar, flat bar, tubing, lipped channels and base plates, with laser and profile cutting available for custom jobs. Based in Klerksoord, Pretoria, Palisade Factory suits homeowners wanting a DIY kit as much as contractors needing fencing manufactured, delivered and installed to a specific design.

Peermed Health Centre, in Pretoria Central, is a multidisciplinary health facility bringing together a dispensing doctor, dentist, optometrist and gynaecologist alongside an on-site dispensary and laboratory under one roof. Its diagnostic services include radiology and X-rays, ultrasound and 4D ultrasound, DNA paternity testing and vitamin and mineral drip therapy, plus COVID testing for patients needing that specific screening.

That combination lets a patient move between a consultation, a scan and a prescription without being referred elsewhere for each step. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5:30pm and Saturdays from 8am to 1pm, Peermed Health Centre is based on Madiba Street in Pretoria Central and suits patients wanting general practice, dentistry, optometry and diagnostic imaging available together in a single centre.

Pinnacle College Copperleaf is a co-ed private day school offering Grade 00 to 12 education from its campus in Mnandi, near the Ernie Els Golf Course in Centurion. The school is a member of the Independent Schools Association of Southern Africa, with its curriculum and standards evaluated regularly to maintain that accreditation.

The school frames its approach around building an emotionally intelligent and caring learning culture, pairing a dynamic academic curriculum with diverse extramural activities and day-to-day pastoral support, and places particular emphasis on celebrating South Africa's multicultural community while rejecting discrimination and prejudice in the classroom. Based in Copperleaf Golf Estate, Centurion, Pinnacle College Copperleaf suits families wanting a private school covering the foundation, intermediate and senior phases on one campus from Grade 00 through matric.

Plumb-Avid, operating from Raslouw in Centurion, is a plumbing company offering 24/7 emergency call-outs for issues that cannot wait, alongside planned work such as clearing blocked drains, geyser repairs and leak detection. The business has built a strong local reputation, holding a 4.9-star rating on Google from its customer base.

Its range extends beyond core plumbing to ceiling repairs where water damage or sagging has left a ceiling needing attention, water purification and filtration system installation, water backup solutions, bathroom work and gutter cleaning. Based in Celtisdal, Centurion, Plumb-Avid suits homeowners facing an urgent plumbing emergency as well as those planning routine maintenance such as a bathroom upgrade or gutter clean.

Pmplus Projects Strategy Consultants, based in Cambridge Office Park, Centurion, is a multi-discipline built environment consulting firm with offices extending into Gauteng and Mpumalanga. Its project management division has built a track record of jump-starting projects and introducing management control systems that give a project a solid foundation from the outset.

The firm's quantity surveying service focuses on the client's business needs, delivering cost management that supports informed decision-making, while its project strategy consulting arm performs detailed, tailored assessments backed by quantitative and qualitative analysis. A dedicated Civil/Structural Engineering division, established during the company's early years, rounds out its built environment offering. Based in The Reeds, Centurion, Pmplus suits clients needing project management, quantity surveying and civil or structural engineering input managed through a single consultancy.

PostNet Eldoraigne, trading from Eldoraigne Village on Saxby Avenue, is a courier and business-services outlet offering domestic and international courier services alongside black and white, full-colour and wide-format copying and printing. The branch also supplies stationery and broader digital business solutions for customers needing more than just a parcel sent.

Trading hours are published directly on the branch's own store page: Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturdays from 8am to 1pm, closed on Sundays and public holidays. Based in Eldoraigne, Centurion, PostNet Eldoraigne suits local residents and businesses needing courier, printing and stationery services handled at one neighbourhood branch rather than several separate suppliers.

items.description:
Pretoria East Testing Station, established in 2001 in Jan Niemand Park, is a privately owned A-Grade vehicle testing station fully licensed under the National Road Traffic Act. It offers roadworthy testing for light and heavy-duty vehicles, motorcycles, trailers and caravans, as well as specialised testing for ambulances and Cash-in-Transit vehicles.

As an A-Grade station the business complies with SABS regulations across every test it performs, including brake and performance checks and headlight adjustment, stability and performance testing. Based in Jan Niemand Park, Pretoria, and open Monday to Friday from 8am to 4:30pm, Pretoria East Testing Station suits private motorists and commercial fleet operators needing a fully licensed, compliant testing station for standard or specialised vehicles alike.

Pretoria Mansion Boutique Hotel, in Waterkloof Heights, offers rooms with a private balcony overlooking forest views, positioning itself as a quiet retreat set within a secure, private section of Pretoria. Guests can unwind at the property's swimming pool or gather at its braai and bar area, where barbecue facilities and a stocked bar support both relaxed afternoons and larger get-togethers.

Breakfast is served on site, and the hotel also offers conference and function facilities for guests wanting to combine a stay with a meeting or event in the same venue. Based in Waterkloof Heights, Pretoria, Pretoria Mansion Boutique Hotel suits travellers wanting a tranquil, privately run guesthouse rather than a large hotel, with space to host a small function without changing location.

ProEthics, based in Nieuw Muckleneuk, is a professional ethics consultancy that works with clients to promote business integrity and combat the economic crime and dishonest practices that can damage both profit and service delivery. Its team combines academic grounding with practical business experience, giving it the footing to offer expert legal advice alongside tailor-made in-house training courses built around a client's specific compliance needs.

As a micro-enterprise, the practice works directly and personally with each client rather than through layers of account management, an approach it credits with building long-term partnerships across both private and public sector organisations. Based in Muckleneuk, Pretoria, ProEthics suits corporations, municipalities and government departments wanting hands-on ethics investigations and training rather than a generic compliance checklist.

Prosopa Restaurant, in Waterkloof Heights, comes from a family with generations in the restaurant business, serving Mediterranean-inspired food with a deliberately South African identity: ingredients and wines are sourced locally wherever possible, drawing on the country's own gastronomic diversity rather than importing a fixed European menu. A private dining room is available for guests wanting a function or gathering away from the main floor.

Its wine list has earned a Diners Club Diamond award, built from a selection its own team has tasted bottle by bottle, running from easy wines by the glass to more serious local and imported vintages, alongside craft beer, cocktails and single malt whiskeys for guests who prefer something other than wine. Based in Waterkloof Heights, Pretoria, Prosopa Restaurant suits diners wanting a considered wine pairing as much as those simply after a warm, family-run Mediterranean meal.

items.description:
PTP Building Services, based in Derdepoort, Pretoria, takes on both residential and commercial construction work. On the residential side it covers tiling, painting, electrical work and LP gas installations, giving homeowners a single contractor able to handle several trades across the same renovation rather than coordinating separate specialists for each job.

Its commercial portfolio has included healthcare facilities, industrial sites and warehouse development, projects that call for the same standard of workmanship as a private home but carried out at a larger scale and with stricter compliance requirements. Based in Derdepoort, Pretoria, PTP Building Services suits homeowners needing multiple trades coordinated on one renovation as well as businesses commissioning industrial, warehouse or healthcare-related building work.

items.description:
Quatro Integrated Services, based in Equestria, Pretoria, positions itself as an integrated facilities partner rather than a single-service contractor, with its leadership team directly involved in daily operations to keep each site accountable. Its cleaning division uses eco-friendly methods and site-specific equipment across commercial and industrial sites, covering daily office and retail cleaning through to industrial deep cleaning and specialist healthcare and high-rise work.

Alongside cleaning, Quatro runs a hygiene and pest control division that installs eco-friendly washroom systems and carries out pest treatments and sanitisation for commercial and industrial clients, plus a dedicated security offering built on the same integrated model. More than two-thirds of its clients have stayed with the company for over ten years. Based in Equestria, Pretoria, Quatro Integrated Services suits businesses wanting cleaning, hygiene and security managed by one accountable provider rather than several separate contractors.

Quick buy houses, operating from Amandasig, is a cash home-buying service that purchases properties directly from sellers across South Africa, from township homes to houses in leafy suburbs, without agents, showings or repair work required beforehand. The company says it buys with its own funds rather than waiting on a buyer's bond approval, which lets it make a free, no-obligation cash offer within 24 hours of a seller getting in touch.

Sellers can choose their own move-out date, and the company's own conveyancers manage the transfer paperwork and keep the seller updated throughout, with more than 500 homes bought for cash to date and sales completed in as little as seven days. Based in Amandasig, Pretoria, Quick buy houses suits homeowners wanting a fast, fee-free sale on a property in any condition rather than a traditional listing through an estate agent.

items.description:
RBM Kontrakteurs, based in Waverley, Pretoria, is a renovation contractor built around more than 25 years of experience in kitchen improvements, with the owner describing renovation work as a personal passion rather than just a trade. Kitchen projects typically focus on making the space more functional, covering appliance placement, island positioning and improved lighting, alongside upgrades to flooring, countertops and cabinetry that change the look of the room.

The business extends the same approach to bathroom renovations, where new floor tiles and cabinetry can transform a bathroom's overall appearance just as effectively as a kitchen upgrade. Based in Waverley, Pretoria, RBM Kontrakteurs suits homeowners planning a kitchen or bathroom renovation who want a contractor involved in every stage of the project rather than handing it over and waiting for a result.

RENT-A-STORE Centurion Self Storage, in Heuweloord, offers storage units sized from 1 square metre up to 54 square metres to suit anything from a few boxes to a full household move. New customers pay no security deposit and no move-in admin fees, and the facility throws in free use of a truck or trailer for the initial move-in, cutting one of the bigger costs of relocating.

Security is built around state-of-the-art systems and procedures, and the facility itself is kept clean and well-maintained, including its restrooms and relaxation areas, backed by a team the company describes as focused on a hassle-free customer experience. Based in Heuweloord, Centurion, RENT-A-STORE suits households mid-move and businesses needing flexible, secure storage without committing to a long lease or large upfront costs.

SIMUMECH, based in Sinoville, Pretoria, is a mechanical engineering consultancy serving clients in South Africa, Australia and beyond, including petroleum refineries, process and food processing plants, mines, factories, steel fabricators and engineering workshops. Its core services cover finite element analysis, pipe stress analysis and piping design, pressure vessel and storage tank design, mechanical design and fitness-for-service assessments.

The practice also offers professional engineering verification work, and its team holds professional registrations including ECSA, CPEng and RPEQ alongside other international engineering credentials, giving clients sign-off from internationally recognised qualifications rather than an unregistered consultant. Based in Sinoville, Pretoria, SIMUMECH suits industrial and process-plant operators needing specialist mechanical engineering analysis and design rather than general civil or structural consulting.

Smartin Solutions, based in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, Centurion, is a software consultancy built around a small, mathematically minded team that favours lean, practical fixes over unnecessary rebuilds. Its process starts with a gap analysis that embeds with a client's own teams to find real bottlenecks and quantify their impact before any code is written, followed by solution architecture that favours existing platforms and open-source tools where they make sense.

From there the company delivers full in-house software development through to deployment, including systems integration across ERP, finance and healthcare platforms, WhatsApp and Shopify, plus SYSPRO and Espresso workflow extensions and KPI dashboards built with Dynatrace observability. Past work spans secure medical aid integration for a healthcare client, manufacturing workflow extensions and retail operational dashboards. Based in Centurion, Smartin Solutions suits businesses wanting measured, outcome-driven software development rather than an open-ended retainer.

SMEC South Africa, based in La Montagne, Pretoria, is the local office of a global engineering, project management and development consultancy known for technical excellence and reliable delivery on major infrastructure projects. Its specialist capabilities span roads, bridges and highways, rail and metro systems, water and wastewater, hydro and dams, ports and maritime, energy and renewables, environment, urban communities, international development and aviation.

The firm has been involved in some of the world's most complex transport megaprojects, from feasibility through to delivery, and traces its commitment to clean energy back to one of the most ambitious pumped hydropower schemes ever undertaken. Based in La Montagne, Pretoria, SMEC South Africa suits public and private clients needing infrastructure engineering backed by an international firm's design experience across high-density urban settings and remote sites alike.

Solar Europe, based in Onderstepoort, imports and distributes solar equipment under a wide range of brands rather than a single house label, stocking panels from Jinko, JA Solar, Astronergy, Trina, Seraphim and Longi alongside inverters from Deye, Dyness, Lux Power, Megarevo and SRNE in grid-tie, hybrid and off-grid configurations. Its battery range covers lithium-ion options including Deye LiFePO4, Dyness, Shoto and HinaESS cells, with dedicated cabinets for several of these brands.

Beyond the core solar line-up, the company supplies EV chargers, generators, gas geysers, and the switchgear, cabling, connectors and mounting brackets needed to complete an installation. Open Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 4:30pm and Saturdays from 8am to 2pm, Solar Europe is based in Onderstepoort, Pretoria, and suits installers and homeowners wanting a choice of recognised component brands from one importer rather than a single proprietary system.

Solar Europe, trading from Onderstepoort as a solar product importer, manufacturer and distributor, supplies solar panels from brands including Jinko, JA Solar, Astronergy, Trina, Seraphim and Longi, alongside its own INGE panel optimiser and MPPT testing equipment for installers wanting to check a system's performance. Its inverter range covers grid-tie, hybrid and off-grid models from Deye, Dyness, Lux Power, Megarevo and SRNE, built for installations of different sizes and backup requirements.

The company's lithium-ion battery line includes Deye LiFePO4, Dyness, Shoto and HinaESS cells with matching cabinets, and its catalogue extends to AC and DC switchgear, earthing cables and connectors, solar mounting brackets, gas geysers, generators and EV chargers for a complete off-grid or grid-tied setup. Open Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 4:30pm and Saturdays from 8am to 2pm, Solar Europe suits installers and solar retailers in Pretoria wanting a single wholesale source for panels, inverters, batteries and the components that tie a system together.

SOS Advertising SA, based in Daspoort, Pretoria, has worked in marketing and promotions for more than 15 years, built around the idea of becoming a lifelong partner to small and medium businesses rather than a one-off supplier. Its services span website hosting and development, ongoing marketing and promotional campaigns, and audio and video production handled through its own in-house studio.

The company also runs a graphic design training course with an attached internship programme, giving newcomers a route into the industry while supplying the business with trained design support. It has built up more than 500 satisfied customers and holds a 4.9 client review rating. Based in Daspoort, Pretoria, SOS Advertising SA suits SME owners wanting marketing, web and video production handled by a single long-term partner.

Stanton Porter Marketing, based in Erasmia, Centurion, manages the advertising and marketing for several niche South African publications rather than running campaigns for a single client base. Its portfolio includes Motor News, the weekly Thursday motoring section carried in Business Day, and Landbou Wiele, the monthly motoring section in Landbouweekblad.

The company also handles advertising sales for a bi-monthly trucks, buses and heavy equipment transport magazine, aimed at readers in the logistics and transport sectors, and for Homefront, the monthly Friday property section carried in Business Day. Based in Erasmia, Centurion, Stanton Porter Marketing suits advertisers wanting placement in established, sector-specific motoring, transport or property publications rather than building a campaign from scratch in an unfamiliar title.

Stargas, based in Zwartkop, Centurion, has been delivering LPG gas to homes and businesses across Gauteng since 2009, building 17 years of experience in gas supply and installation. Its drive-through depots let customers exchange an empty cylinder for a full one without waiting, while certified installers handle domestic, commercial and industrial gas installations with the compliance certification each requires.

For business customers the company supplies bulk LPG along with food-grade and industrial gases, and its retail side stocks stoves, heaters, braais and fireplaces for anyone switching an appliance to gas, plus the fittings and parts installers need to keep a job moving. Stargas is LPGSASA certified and operates from nine locations. Based in Zwartkop, Centurion, Stargas suits households wanting a quick cylinder swap as much as businesses needing bulk or industrial gas supply.

Stem Connect, based in Waterkloof Park, Pretoria, takes a fibre-first approach to business connectivity, adding wireless and LTE options only where they genuinely make sense for a particular site rather than defaulting to them. Its Managed Site packages are built in tiers: Essential covers reliable primary connectivity with managed equipment and monitoring, Resilient adds an independent backup line with automatic failover, and Critical layers in diverse connectivity, SD-WAN, managed security and 24/7 operations with formal reporting.

For businesses with several branches, its Multi-Site Network applies one design, rollout, support and reporting model across every location rather than treating each site as a separate project. Based in Waterkloof Park, Pretoria, Stem Connect suits businesses that cannot absorb a long outage at a site and want connectivity, equipment and supplier management handled as a single managed service.

Stuttafords traded at Menlyn Park Shopping Centre as one of the mall's largest anchor stores, part of a department store chain founded in Cape Town in 1858 that became known as the "Harrods of South Africa." The chain grew to operate stores across South Africa, Botswana and Namibia, employing around 950 people by the time of its closure.

After 159 years of trading, the South African operation was liquidated in August 2017, with the brand continuing to operate only in Namibia today. Based at Menlyn Park Shopping Centre, Atterbury Road, Menlyn, the Stuttafords name remains part of the shopping centre's retail history for shoppers who remember it as one of Pretoria's upscale department store destinations.

Synergy Video Productions, based in Wingate Park, Pretoria East, is a full-service corporate video production company with 18 years in the industry, working with clients ranging from small businesses to large international companies. Its output covers corporate and explainer videos, 2D and 3D animation, training and induction videos, virtual reality productions, promotional videos and brand films.

The studio also produces virtual tours, event videos, marketing videos and TV commercials, and offers monthly retainer packages that it says can cut a client's production costs by more than half compared with commissioning videos individually. Based in Wingate Park, Pretoria East, Synergy Video Productions suits businesses across manufacturing, mining, tourism, logistics, financial services and other sectors wanting an ongoing video production partner rather than a single one-off project.

TBi - Team Building Institute, based in Wapadrand, Pretoria, grew from a small start in a family house store room in 1994 into a team-development company built on Adventure-related Experiential Learning, a methodology developed from academic doctoral research. The approach draws on four disciplines, psychology, philosophy, human movement sciences and business science, to design programmes tailored to a specific workplace issue rather than a generic team-building day.

Its programme range covers recreational team building for year-end functions, Industry 4.0 upskilling, conflict management, project management and stress management, supported by HBDI assessments and dedicated facilitator training for organisations wanting to run their own sessions. Based in Wapadrand, Pretoria, TBi suits corporate clients needing a scientifically grounded alternative to an off-the-shelf team-building exercise.

The Energy Gurus, based in Gateway Industrial Park, Louwlardia, Centurion, designs and installs energy and solar projects for commercial and agricultural clients, organising its own project showcase around those two categories rather than treating every installation the same way. Its completed work includes projects for Hy-Line International, Cornwall Hill College, ComAfrica, MAN Bus and Coach and Square@Midstream, spanning agriculture, education, communications, transport and commercial property.

The business documents its own installation approach under a stated methodology, and backs completed projects with ongoing system maintenance rather than leaving a client to find a separate service provider once a system is installed. Open Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, The Energy Gurus is based in Louwlardia, Centurion, and suits commercial and agricultural operations wanting an energy partner for both the installation and its long-term upkeep.

The Wine Shop by Caraffa, in Alphen Park, is a boutique wine shop built around all-day breakfast and lunch service, with wine as the clear focus rather than an afterthought to the food menu. The shop runs a Wine of the Month feature and hosts complimentary wine tastings every Thursday from 5pm to 7pm, giving regular customers a reason to drop in and try something new each week.

Its range includes wines from Hartenberg Wine Estate in Stellenbosch, among others, chosen for reflecting both the character of the land they come from and the winemaker's own approach to balancing tradition with a more modern style. Based in Alphen Park, Pretoria, The Wine Shop by Caraffa suits those wanting a relaxed breakfast or lunch alongside a carefully chosen glass of wine rather than a standard coffee-shop menu.

items.description:
Val de Grace Vet CREW, in Val-De-Grace, Pretoria, is an animal hospital offering routine oral health care alongside urgent and emergency treatment for pets that cannot wait for a scheduled appointment. The practice partners with Labradoor Vets to help tailor regular checkups to each pet's specific needs rather than running every animal through the same standard visit.

Client testimonials point to particular experience with exotic and unusual pets, including bearded dragons and pet rats, conditions that many general practices are less equipped to handle. The hospital offers home visit requests for owners unable to bring an animal in, and online consultation bookings for routine care. Open Monday to Friday from 7am to 6pm and Saturdays from 8am to 1pm, Val de Grace Vet CREW suits pet owners with exotic or unusual animals as much as those with everyday cats and dogs.

Venter IT Services, based in Moregloed, Pretoria, supports home users and small businesses through a branded framework it calls the Four Pillars: monitoring, endpoint protection, backup and support. Its flagship House Venter Complete service bundles all four into one managed monthly package, combining ongoing monitoring with managed endpoint security, managed cloud backup and priority support.

For clients who want protection without committing to a fully managed service, the company also offers standalone IT security and cloud backup options that can be taken on their own. Based in Moregloed, Pretoria, Venter IT Services suits home users and small businesses wanting either a complete managed IT package or specific security and backup protection on its own.

Vermaak Attorneys, with a Centurion office in Kloofsig, is a law firm also operating from Johannesburg, offering legal services to clients across South Africa and internationally. Its practice areas cover municipal law, property law, commercial law, alternative dispute resolution, criminal law and insolvency law, giving it a broad general practice rather than a narrow specialism.

The firm's team works in English, Afrikaans and isiXhosa, and the practice describes its mission as providing personalised, strategic legal solutions built around each client's specific circumstances rather than a standard template. Based in Kloofsig, Centurion, Vermaak Attorneys suits clients needing municipal, property or commercial law advice from a firm with reach into both Pretoria and Johannesburg.

items.description:
viZin Group, trading as IT Network from Wierda Park, Centurion, is a recruitment and staffing firm with more than two decades of experience in talent management for the IT sector. Its services cover recruitment and staffing placements, contractor management including payroll, contracts and recruitment process outsourcing, and support services such as CV and profile preparation and background checks.

Through its HR team, the company also assists with payroll services, relocation and work permit support, and tax advisory for contractors working across borders, while its TechStar Hub offers a route into its wider candidate database for IT professionals seeking new placements. Based in Wierda Park, Centurion, viZin Group suits both IT employers needing contractor and payroll management handled externally and IT professionals looking for their next role.

Vorster & Brandt Inc, based in Ashlea Gardens, Pretoria, is a law firm offering a wide spread of practice areas rather than a single specialism, covering business rescue and insolvency, conveyancing and property law, civil litigation, and labour and employment law for both employers and employees. Its further practice areas include commercial law, personal law, family law and personal injury and medical negligence litigation.

The firm also handles correspondent instructions and referrals from other practices, along with trusts and estates work, and offers online appointment scheduling for clients wanting to book a consultation without an initial phone call. Based in Ashlea Gardens, Pretoria, Vorster & Brandt Inc suits clients needing a general practice firm able to handle matters spanning property, commercial, family and personal injury law under one roof.

Weir Consulting, based in Sterrewag, Pretoria, is a property scheme management advisory led by a Chartered Accountant and Certified Internal Auditor with more than 20 years of experience in property finance. The practice works with trustees and chairpersons to bring clarity to scheme finances and reduce arrears, with managing agents through independent reviews and mediation, and with owners and residents through a neutral, confidential process for resolving disputes without resorting to costly litigation.

Its core services include mediation covering governance, levy issues and common property disputes, property financial reviews delivered as board-ready reports, Sectional Titles Act and Companies Act training for trustees and directors, and compliance reviews that flag the risk of non-compliance and personal liability. Based in Sterrewag, Pretoria, Weir Consulting suits sectional title and homeowners' association schemes needing independent financial oversight and dispute resolution.

Willows Country Lodge, in The Willows, Pretoria, is a boutique hotel and conference centre set on a two-hectare estate against the Bronberg Mountain Nature Reserve, offering 25 individually decorated guest rooms with views over landscaped gardens and capacity for 51 guests. Breakfast is included, and the property's amenities cover a swimming pool, spa and wellness centre, restaurant and bar, and room service.

Business guests are catered for through dedicated conference rooms, and the lodge arranges airport transfers, car hire and tours for visitors without their own transport, alongside a braai and BBQ area for guests wanting to self-cater an evening meal. Based in The Willows, Pretoria, Willows Country Lodge suits both leisure travellers wanting a tranquil nature-reserve setting and business guests needing conference facilities on site.

Zutari Head Office is the Pretoria base of Zutari, a multinational buildings and infrastructure engineering and advisory practice with a legacy spanning more than 90 years and 32 offices across 17 countries in Africa and the Middle East. The firm says its engineering solutions have reached 53 countries, built on a human-centred design approach and deep technical expertise across its various disciplines.

Its service lines cover buildings, climate and sustainability, data centres, digital and information management, energy and power, ground engineering, mining and industrial infrastructure, programme and project management, transport and mobility, and urban and regional development. Based in Ashlea Gardens, Pretoria, Zutari Head Office suits clients needing infrastructure engineering backed by a multinational practice with decades of experience across Africa and the Middle East.

Afro Fire and Safety cc, based in Rietfontein, Pretoria, is a SABS-certified fire protection company offering compliance services across South Africa. Its core offering spans fire protection and suppression systems, sprinkler systems, and detection and alarm installations, covering the main systems a building needs to meet fire safety requirements.

The business also handles building maintenance and runs fire training courses, and gives clients access to a dedicated client portal, free safety tools and a published FAQ covering common compliance questions. Based in Rietfontein, Pretoria, Afro Fire and Safety cc suits businesses needing fire detection, suppression and compliance work handled by a single SABS-certified provider rather than separate specialists for each system.

Appsolve, based in Midstream Estate, Centurion, is an IT consultancy structured around five service lines: Simplify consulting, custom software and app development, product implementation, ongoing support services, and cloud services. Its own product range includes BeBanking, an end-to-end secure host-to-host banking solution, AppSolve Agri, a cloud-based supply chain management system for agricultural clients, and APPTime, a cloud-based back-office system covering time capture, contract management and invoicing.

Client endorsements include Mazda Southern Africa, which has used Appsolve's skilled resources over several years, and ARM IT, which highlights the value of the company's monthly performance reviews as part of its service. Based in Midstream Estate, Centurion, Appsolve suits businesses needing custom software built in-house or looking for a ready-made product such as BeBanking or AppSolve Agri rather than building a system from scratch.
